summary: Mission rows carry st's presentation: the mission word, who must act, each step, the stuck step and what a person can do

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. Mission rows gain an optional presentation object (MissionPresentation in client-v0.schema.json); the generated clients gain its types.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Additive and optional; older clients ignore it. Until st has published an agents roster, a card whose word would hinge on an agent's queue carries none, and every other card carries one read without agents. No client reads it yet in this release.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption. The missions refresher computes each refolded card's presentation, reads the open human gates with the attention it already reads, wakes on roster publications, and refolds the missions whose gates or agents changed.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions.
